headline: Google is promoting a set of tools that let AI agents and developers pull its official documentation.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered 1: a vendor promotion whose headline ('supercharge') claims more than the post shows, and it gives no launch date.
importance_line: Developers building AI agents on Google Cloud could use these tools to get current Google documentation, but the post is product promotion with no launch date or independent check.
summary: Google's developers blog describes its Developer Knowledge API, which serves Google's documentation for Google Cloud, Firebase and Android to AI agents and coding tools as Markdown text, with a command-line tool, an official agent skill, an API explorer and client libraries for several languages. The post gives no launch date, so readers cannot tell which of these tools are new.
notes: Read in full (Google's own developers blog). Promotional post; the pool score was 5. Watchlist only unless the editor keeps it.
